title: Ember AI — Sales Assistant for Client Follow-Up
excerpt: AI sales assistant that drafts client follow-ups in your voice from your real inbox. Approval is the default; auto-send is optional.
content_html:
Automated Relationship Management (ARM)

Every relationship in your pipeline, handled start to finish.

Ember connects to your email and CRM, understands every relationship you have, and determines the next action for each one. Then it does the work, so every deal keeps advancing, day and night.

app.withember.ai

LH

Lena Hart

VP Operations · Northline Manufacturing

Evaluating

RelationshipProspectDeal stageEvaluatingEmberManaged

Relationship summary

VP Operations at a manufacturer who owns the rollout. We’re building trust, they’re evaluating on the operations platform.

One relationship: who they are, where the deal stands, what happens next.

Minute one

Sync your accounts. Ember finds your best prospects.

Connect the inbox and CRM you already run. Ember reads the entire history, sorts buyers from noise, and puts the people worth managing on your pipeline. This is not another CRM. No sequences to build.

How it works

Syncs on top of the email and CRM you already run.

Ember is not designed to replace them. It reads the relationships you already have, and handles the next move.

Inbox

CRM

→

Ember

System of action

Not another CRM

No migration. Your CRM stays the system of record.

Not a sequence tool

No cadences, templates, or a canvas to build.

Sends as you

From the inbox you already use, with your approval when you want it.

On top of the stack you already run

Gmail

Outlook

Attio

HubSpot

SalesforceSoon

The intelligence

Best-in-class relationship intelligence.

Like nothing you have used before. Ember times the move, knows the person, and keeps the book full.

A reply lands at 6:47am.

The response is drafted and waiting in your queue before you've opened your laptop.

Waiting for your approval

A contact goes quiet mid-deal.

Ember picks the right moment to re-engage, and leads with something they actually need.

Timed to their calendar

Someone said reach out in July.

Ember waits until July, then opens with something new and worth their time. Not a check-in.

Send date honored

A new contact comes in.

Ember figures out whether they're a real lead or a bad fit, before you spend a minute on them.

Matches your buyer profile

A contact changes jobs.

Ember updates their profile and re-reads the relationship, so you're never selling to the wrong version of someone.

Relationship re-read

A new name shows up on a thread.

CC'd, mentioned, or sitting in a meeting: Ember adds them, reads where they fit, and starts a strategy.

Strategy started

Wake up to progress, not a backlog.

Ember advances relationships continuously. You come back to deals that moved in the last day, not a stack of follow-ups you never got to.
